th `409 CONFLICT` and `details.reason: \"CI_OWNED_SUITE_READ_ONLY\"`.\n\nRunning, replaying, comparing and DELETING are unaffected
\u2014 deleting a suite is not editing one, and it is the only cleanup an SDK-created suite has. To change a CI-owned suite, eith
er edit its file and send that file's `suite.id` as `declaredSuiteId` on the write, or duplicate the suite for an editable copy.\n
\n`declaredId` alone is not this answer: a suite created by SDK ingest is CI-owned and has no declared id.", "enum": ["ci", "app"]
